messages:
Noah: Uploaded a new one-pager 'Guardian: Secure Serving Snapshot'  single-page brief focused on SLAs, network modes (VPC/on-prem), and a compact benchmark. Need quick review + CTA pick. doc: https://docs.google.com/d/guardian123
Ravi: Solid. Suggest a concise benchmark card + a one-line about failover behavior (model fallback + canary rollbacks). Keep language plain for sales.
Emma: For inbound, we should auto-attach when form field 'enterprise' OR checkbox 'requires SLA' is set. Also route any 'air-gapped' or 'on-prem' requests to SEs and trigger legal review.
Noah: Draft benchmark text: "p95 latency ~140ms for typical generative requests; hosted cost est. $0.018 / 1k tokens; dedicated infra can lower unit cost by ~30% at sustained load." Ravi, can you tighten that?
Ravi: Tightened: "p95 ≈ 140ms (gen); hosted ≈ $0.018 / 1k tokens; dedicated capacity can cut unit cost ~30% at steady utilization." Good for a little stat card.
Emma: Inbound pseudo-rule example:
```
- if form.fields.contains('requires_SLA') OR lead.tags.includes('enterprise'):
    attach: Guardian-onepager.pdf
    assign: enterprise-ops
    escalate: high
- if form.request.includes('on-prem') OR form.request.includes('air-gapped'):
    assign: solutions-engineering; notify: security@redwood.com
- else:
    assign: growth-sdr
```
Emma: Also create an SDR note template: "Lead needs SLA scoping; attach Guardian; propose 30m scoping call."
Noah: CTA options: 'Download Guardian: SLAs & deployment checklist' (gated) or 'Request a deployment scoping call' (high-touch). Recommend first as primary.
Ravi: Webinar tie-in: use the one-pager as the post-webinar handout and include the stat card image in the follow-up. Suggested email subject: 'Operationalizing secure LLM serving: SLAs, VPCs, and fallbacks.'
Emma: I'll push the inbound rules to the playbook and set up the auto-attach. ETA tomorrow AM.
Noah: I'll finalize the microcopy and upload the PDF. Ravi: please export the stat card art specs for design.
InboundBot: Event created: 'Guardian one-pager final review' Thu 9:00 AM. Invitees: Noah, Ravi, Emma.
